Visitor skip action omits all headings from output

```java title="Java"
import io.xberg.htmltomarkdown.*;

public final class Example {
    public static void main(String[] args) throws Exception {
        class _TestVisitor implements HtmlVisitor {
            @Override public VisitResult visitHeading(NodeContext ctx, int level, String text, String id) {
                return new VisitResult.Skip();
            }
        }
        var visitor = new _TestVisitor();
        var result = HtmlToMarkdownRs.convert("<h1>Title</h1><p>Body text remains.</p>", ConversionOptions.builder().withVisitor(visitor).build());
        System.out.println(result.content());
    }
}
```
